method: Compared with the pdftotext text layer (raw and -layout modes) of the official SQP and MS PDFs from .sources-cache/p3/cbse-sqp-2025-26-xii-physics/ (SHA-256 checked against source.sha256).

source.notes: SQP SHA-256 matches source.sha256 exactly. Both PDFs are on cbseacademic.nic.in (the board's own domain). Title 'PHYSICS - Code No. 042', 'SAMPLE QUESTION PAPER', 'CLASS - XII (2025-26)', Time Allowed 3 hours, Maximum Marks 70 all match the pack's stored metadata. The MS PDF has no separate stored hash field in the pack; it was located alongside the SQP in the same cache folder and its content was cross-checked question by question.
